_comment: Keys that appear in en.json / ar.json but are only looked up at runtime via
computed keys (e.g. `t('dyn.risks.status.' + row.status)`) — never via a
static `data-i18n` attribute or a string-literal `t('...')` call.
Every entry is a DOT-PREFIX: any dictionary key whose dotted path STARTS
WITH the prefix (including the trailing dot) is excluded from the unused-key
check so it stays actionable without producing false positives.
When you add a new dynamic lookup in dashboard/**/*.html or dashboard/js/**,
add its prefix here with a one-line comment explaining where it is used.
Remove an entry only after confirming no runtime code references that prefix.
